text:
Before the meal, the tray held two slices of toast (whole grain, about 30 g each, roughly 60 g total), two strawberry jam portions (about 14 g each, 28 g total), and a cup of tea.

The tea appears black or with little milk, so it adds almost no energy. The mug in the second photo looks empty, so I counted the tea as consumed, at around 0 to 2 kcal.

Toast: 60 g at roughly 250 kcal per 100 g comes to about 150 kcal. Toasting dries the bread slightly, but the slices look thin, so about 140 kcal is a reasonable figure.

Jam: 28 g at about 250 kcal per 100 g comes to about 70 kcal. The empty containers still show some residue, so I assumed about 90% was eaten, or roughly 25 g and 63 kcal.

Total energy is about 140 + 63 + 2 ≈ 205 kcal.

Mass: toast 60 g + jam 25 g = 85 g, excluding the tea. If I counted the tea as roughly 250 g, the total would be about 335 g. I'm reporting food only, so 85 g.
